# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_017_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 17

**1** Jesus said: "I will give you what no eye [вал] has seen and what no ear [ماше] has heard and what no hand [чіж] has touched and what has never occurred to the human mind [хнт нроме]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *вал*: eye; what no eye has seen
- *ماше*: ear; what no ear has heard
- *чіж*: hand; what no hand has touched — Thomas adds a third member not in Paul
- *хнт нроме*: the heart/mind of a human being; the seat of thought and imagination
- cf. 1 Cor 2:9: "What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the human heart conceived, what God has prepared for those who love him" — Paul appears to quote a tradition closely related to this saying
- Paul attributes it to scripture ("as it is written"); the tradition may have been more widely known
- Thomas's version adds the "hand" member — tactile experience excluded as well as visual and auditory
- "Never occurred to the human mind" renders the fourth member: complete transcendence of imagination
